Review of render_statement (request_changes): I found the cause of the conflicting tests. The implementation has a special case `if not posted: return [_balance_line("Closing balance", opening_cents)]` which only returns a closing balance line when there are no transactions. This contradicts the docstring example which shows both 'Opening balance' and 'Closing balance' being returned. You should remove this special case so the standard logic (which includes the opening balance line) applies to empty transactions.
